diff --git a/rich/console.py b/rich/console.py
index 3ec9a8aa..0758879a 100644
--- a/rich/console.py
+++ b/rich/console.py
@@ -954,6 +954,13 @@ class Console:
             self._force_terminal = True
             return True
 
+        # TTY_COMPATIBLE env var overrides TTY detection: "0" means not a tty, "1" means tty.
+        tty_compatible = self._environ.get("TTY_COMPATIBLE", "")
+        if tty_compatible == "0":
+            return False
+        if tty_compatible == "1":
+            return True
+
         isatty: Optional[Callable[[], bool]] = getattr(self.file, "isatty", None)
         try:
             return False if isatty is None else isatty()
